text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"—What's the matter?! Is that all the bite 
your fangs have?! 
I'm tired of playing around... I'll tear 
you all to shreds!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Hah, it seems the 'Monster' enjoys 
howling. 
Then next, my blade shall make you let out 
a meek, delicate cry!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
S-So cool...! A banquet of Triple Crown 
horsegirls, it really is the best... 
Rudolf-san's sheer presence is just 
irresistible...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Brian's aura is insane too... and whoa, 
C.B.-san's moves 
are so light on her feet, right?! Wow, 
this is too lavish... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on... What's happening at the 
other cafe is going totally viral?! 
Isn't this place, if I remember correctly—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Come closer. 
Step right in to a world of enchantment, a 
sea of desire, an exquisite cradle—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Beckoned by the dark, you've wandered 
right into my grasp... 
How truly foolish of you――――human."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"However, you are in luck. This is 
the domain ruled by our Demonic Empress... 
Savor the great fortune of having lost 
your way here."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Greedy newcomer. Taste our 'Amber Demonic 
Blood' to your heart's content. 
And rejoice, former human. With this, you 
have become a minion of our Empress."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"What you drank down was a single drop of 
my magical power... 
The darkness dwelling within will course 
through your veins alongside your blood, 
eventually corrupting all that you are."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Fret not, there is nothing to fear. 
Entrust your everything into my arms. 
Yield to the darkness budding within you, 
to your desires, to your devotion to 
me—and obey."

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"I will serve you with all my heart and 
soul, Demonic Empress!!" 
"At the whim of my desires, give me 
pancakes, a parfait, and a tart, please!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"The line for the 'Demonic Empress Cafe' 
is crazy! Isn't it the most popular one?!" 
"Oh no, this is an endless pit... I am the 
Demonic Empress's beloved child..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Truly peerless under heaven—I never 
imagined it would reach such heights. 
Not that I ever underestimated her, but 
she still surpasses all expectations.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In short, the awakening of the 'Empress' 
you so looked forward to 
seems to have come to pass splendidly... 
Hm?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian? Where did she go—?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Where? That should be obvious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: To "have some fun"—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: !? Wh-What are you doing here—?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Hey there, beauteous Demonic Empress. 
Ripe, fully matured fighting spirit is 
filling that body of yours. ...Looks 
mighty delicious."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...—"What an utterly insolent beast. 
Do you seek a master to discipline you? If 
so, shall I take up the whip?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"If you think you can tame me with a mere 
whip, you're dreaming. 
I'll twist that arrogant look right off 
your face—here and now!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what are we going to do with 
you—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Both of you, that is enough."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Monster and Empress alike. —Do you 
understand? 
You stand 'Before the King'. Know your 
place."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Ha! Keep talking, you figurehead. Well 
now, both of you 
gaudily dressed showstoppers are here 
together. That makes tearing you apart all 
the more worthwhile!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Heh. ......Haha! ――――Ah, how utterly 
pointess.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(In the end, all of this... 
is nothing more than a foolish way to pass 
the time.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(In the past. And in the future. 
This thirst I carry can only ever be 
quenched by competing, by devouring one 
another.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Naturally, that boiling, surging time is 
what I crave. 
However—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(...—Unexpectedly. This thing called 
life...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (This troublesome thing called living...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(It seems that the peaceful, foolish... 
time spent killing boredom lasts quite a 
long while.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (If so...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(There's plenty of bothersome nonsense. 
No, it's nothing but bothersome nonsense. 
And there are times when that cool, 
composed face of hers genuinely pisses me 
off...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Every single one of them holds up some 
grandiose 'ideal' and 
charges headlong after their ambition. 
—Fools like all of you...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(As company to kill this long, long 
boredom—well, you'll do just fine.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Let me slit that slender white throat of 
yours, Empress. 
Let me shatter that arrogant pride of 
yours, King of Knights!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"It's a banquet of blood. Dance madly and 
entertain me. 
I'm bored. I'm starving. —Come on!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Tch, honestly...!! 
Your tyranny knows no bounds, beast!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Enough of this... 
Don't think a filthy beast like you can 
trample my lands any further!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Wait, what... What should we do—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, this is crazy, totally crazy!! 
What, what, what, how is this gonna end?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It's completely merged with the theater 
cafe's universe! 
Is the Demonic Empress about to get 
kidnapped over to that side...?!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! No, I cannot allow such a thing—!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Groove-nee gave us so much guidance. 
Alv-senpai built this together with us.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(What the two people I deeply respect 
built up to this point... 
I will not let it be destroyed. —...No!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (I will sublimate it! With my own hands!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "――――Stand down, you vile intruders."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Monster. Black Knight King. 
Both of you are utterly unworthy of our 
resplendent Demonic Empress."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Step away from my Master at once. 
If you wish for an opponent, we, the 
Empress's kin, are more than enough."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Come. I shall slaughter you both 
together――!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――――Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, my beloved child. ...Go and 
run wild."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...—In the end, with Duramente-san's hard 
work serving as the deciding blow, 
the improvised play came to a close while 
clearly showing our side's supremacy.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(This event became a huge topic of 
conversation... 
and our cafe enjoyed even greater 
success—)
